question: After runtime's verified byte-preserving nginx HIT-cache substrate (EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543: 960/960 byte-identical across HIT/SWR/SIE/304, oracle-free greedy decode), does a controlled single-resource local perturbation (DOM attribute/text change, endpoint param/header change, Cache-Control/ETag mutation, one resource only) require only localized repair when measured with a real LLM agent (gpt-4o-mini, same model/tools/budget, 15 steps, Playwright) and real verify() on actual DOM/response state: repair tokens <50% and browser interactions <40% vs cold re-exploration, verification AUROC >=0.75 and precision >=0.80, contamination <0.10 (no repair of unrelated resources), and amortized cost < cold at 10 reuses (retrieval+verification+repair amortized), vs COLD and retrieval baselines with trajectory-grouped CIs?
hypothesis: C-DELTA-REPAIR hypothesis (real-substrate remeasurement): a single-resource local perturbation is repairable by a localized patch (re-target selector, rebind param slot, update header expectation, refresh cache key) without full-task re-exploration when measured with a real LLM agent gpt-4o-mini and real Playwright execution with real verify() on actual nginx+Flask state. Operational predictions on held-out TEST (family-stratified 24 TRAIN / 24 TEST from 48 instances: 3 families F-DOM/F-ENDPOINT/F-CACHE x2 variants x8 seeds): (1) localized repair succeeds >=80% pooled and >=70% per-family; (2) mean repair tokens <0.50 * mean B-COLD tokens AND mean browser interactions <0.40 * B-COLD and mean verification steps <=2; (3) verification discriminates correct vs incorrect patch with AUROC >=0.75 and precision >=0.80 at TRAIN-calibrated operating threshold; (4) contamination of unrelated mechanisms <0.10 and random-patch false_accept <5%; (5) amortized cost at n_reuses=10 (repair+verification+10*retrieval_cost) < B-COLD cost (tokens and browser) with trajectory-grouped 95% CIs. Byte-preserving HIT-cache substrate guarantees decompressed body SHA256 identity across HIT/SWR/SIE/304 is >=0.99 pre-perturbation via oracle-free gzip.decompress, so post-perturbation divergence is attributable to controlled local change, not decompression artefacts. Verification and cost non-vacuous: full vector discrimination must exceed body-only and status-only baselines when headers/body vary independently, and CIs must be trajectory-grouped (block permutation by instance/trajectory, not by transition).
falsifier: C-DELTA-REPAIR is falsified (in this single-resource localhost setting) if ANY primary locality condition fails while measurement-validity gates C1-C3 pass on real substrate: (F1) repair success <0.80 pooled OR <0.70 in any family on TEST; (F2) mean repair tokens >=0.50 * B-COLD tokens OR mean browser >=0.40 * B-COLD OR mean verification steps >2 on TEST; (F3) contamination >=0.10 or random-patch false_accept >=5%; (F4) verification AUROC <0.75 OR precision <0.80 at TRAIN threshold on TEST; (F5) amortized repair at n_reuses=10 not cheaper than B-COLD (tokens or browser) on TEST. Global falsification requires failure across all three families; family-specific failure (e.g., DOM passes, ENDPOINT fails) yields MIXED with per-family ceilings and does not falsify entire claim. Measurement failure (C1-C3) yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not falsification. Trajectory-grouped CIs are required for C4-C8 decisions; vacuous full==body==status==1.0 triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per agent-prior #5.

baselines.description: Full cold re-exploration: same real LLM agent gpt-4o-mini (temperature 0.0, max 15 steps, same tools: Playwright goto/click/fill/evaluate/fetch, same budget) solves task from scratch with empty registry and no prior trajectory, via Playwright on localhost nginx+Flask HS256. Measures full task cost in tokens (prompt+completion from API usage), browser interactions (counted Playwright actions with trace logs), verification calls, latency. Trajectory-grouped mean and 95% bootstrap CI by instance.
baselines.expected: Succeeds >=90% but at full cost (100%). Repair must be <50% tokens and <40% browser on TEST to claim locality. CI via trajectory-grouped bootstrap (2000 resamples by instance).

baselines.description: Verbatim mechanism replay without repair (0-token baseline): stored mechanism from pre-perturbation executed unchanged on post-perturbation target via Playwright, no LLM patch. Strong 0-token replay sanity check per agent prior #4: must hit 0% at 0% novelty is not discriminating; here must fail post-perturbation to prove breaking.
baselines.expected: Near 0% success post-perturbation (correctly fails, <10%). If replay succeeds >10%, perturbation non-breaking and instance excluded as non-discriminating. Demonstrates repair adds value beyond trivial reuse.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval over prior trajectory memory (embedding search + nearest successful trajectory replay) without patch, executed via Playwright. Strong retrieval baseline Graph must beat; trajectory-grouped block-permutation null (shuffle retrieval decisions by instance block) required per agent prior #4; 0% hit-rate sanity check on 0% novelty family not counted as success.
baselines.expected: Partial success 20-40% (retrieves correct family but fails on stale locator/header). Repair must exceed retrieval by >=30pp success on TEST with trajectory-grouped CI.

baselines.description: Oracle hand-authored minimal patch (single selector/param/header correction) applied by experimenter, executed and verified via Playwright. Upper-bound ceiling for achievable localized repair (1 probe +1 verify).
baselines.expected: 100% success with 1 browser probe +1 verification. Provides cost ceiling; measured autonomous repair should approach within 2x tokens/steps to be near-optimal, but ceiling alone does not confirm hypothesis.

baselines.description: Runtime verified substrate invariant: oracle-free decompression (gzip.decompress without oracle lookup, handling Content-Encoding, chunked, Vary) yields byte-identical decompressed bodies across HIT, SWR, SIE, 304 on unperturbed resources, on real nginx 1.2x reverse-proxy + Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 + SQLite. Record nginx.conf hash, Flask testbed_server.py commit, decompression code hash. Non-vacuous requirement per agent prior #5: full vector (status+headers+body) must be discriminating beyond body-only and status-only when body varies with perturbation; full==body==status==1.0 is vacuous MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
baselines.expected: >=0.99 SHA256(decompressed_body) identity HIT==SWR==SIE==304 pre-perturbation on real nginx (960/960-equivalent scaled). Post-perturbation HIT body for perturbed resource differs, unperturbed remain >=0.99. If <0.99 or vacuous full==body==status, MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls via identical real LLM gpt-4o-mini+Playwright+verify pipeline with trajectory-grouped scoring: (PC1) Unperturbed execution: mechanism resolved and verified on pre-perturbation endpoint with no patch succeeds verify()=true byte identity >=0.99. (PC2) Known-break single-attribute perturbation with oracle patch: Flask+nginx testbed DOM id #submit-123->#submit-124 and param ?id=->?item= with oracle selector/param update; repair succeeds within 2 browser probes and verification passes cost ratio <0.5 vs B-COLD. Both use real tokens/browser/verify on actual DOM/response.
positive_control.expected: PC1 100% success (Wilson CI reported), PC2 >=90% success with token ratio <0.5 vs B-COLD. If either fails, instrumentation broken — triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

null_control.description: Two null controls via real pipeline with trajectory-grouped permutation: (NC1) Zero perturbation (identical pre/post resource): proposed repair pipeline must produce zero patch (repair patch tokens 0, contamination 0, verify no false patch) byte identity 1.0. (NC2) Distant unrelated perturbation (modify endpoint B while target is endpoint A): repair of A no-op, success unchanged, contamination 0 on B-independent mechanisms. Both tested with trajectory-grouped block-permutation of random-patch decisions (shuffle by instance block, not by transition) to verify false-accept detection AUROC 0.4-0.6 and false_accept <=5%.
null_control.expected: NC1 patch tokens 0 and contamination 0, NC2 contamination 0, random-patch false-accept <=5% and AUROC 0.4-0.6 trajectory-grouped. If NC fails, pipeline mis-calibrated — MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

measurement_validity: Substrate provenance (real, not simulated): nginx 1.2x reverse-proxy with HIT/SWR/SIE/304 caching (Cache-Control max-age, stale-while-revalidate, stale-if-error), Flask 3.1.3 backend PyJWT HS256 HS256 auth SQLite fixture Content-Encoding gzip where applicable oracle-free decompression path (gzip.decompress on raw bytes without oracle lookup). Record nginx.conf hash, Flask testbed_server.py commit, decompression code hash, nginx --version, Python 3.12.14, Playwright 1.63.0, openai version, model id gpt-4o-mini. Verify >=0.99 byte-identical decompressed bodies pre-perturbation (SHA256(decompressed_body) HIT==SWR==SIE==304) on real nginx responses via oracle-free greedy decode; recompute per instance pre and post; require non-vacuous full>body and full>status discrimination when perturbation varies header/body independently (agent prior #5).

Perturbation isolation (single-resource, real DOM/response): each instance mutates exactly one local resource — one DOM node attribute (id/class/data-testid) OR one text node OR one endpoint query param/header name OR one response header (Cache-Control max-age value, ETag value). No global config, no auth migration, no multi-resource drift. Perturbation manifest records file, line, old_value, new_value, blast_radius=1, and is held out from repair agent. Mutations applied to real Flask templates/static and nginx cache keys, observed via Playwright accessibility tree and real HTTP fetches. Cross-condition contamination checked by re-reading unrelated resources via Playwright+fetch.

Pre/post registry snapshot isolation: registry cloned before perturbation (deep copy isolated storage); repair operates on clone; contamination measured as delta on uninvolved mechanism set N>=24 unrelated mechanisms from distinct intents/endpoints using real verify() on actual post-repair state. No leakage of perturbation manifest old->new mapping into repair prompt; repair agent gpt-4o-mini sees only pre-perturbation mechanism + post-perturbation page/response observation (Playwright DOM snapshot + response headers/body) + verify() signal (pass/fail). Prompt logs retained for leakage audit.

Cost measurement transparency (real LLM agent economics, not analytical): tokens = sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) from real openai API usage per call (record model id gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0.0, max_tokens, per-call tokens, 15-step budget enforcement); browser interactions = count(Playwright actions actually executed: goto, click, fill, evaluate, fetch) with trace logs; verification cost = count(verify() + registry lookup + HIT-cache fetch) actually executed; wall-time measured. Full re-exploration cost measured with identical model/tools/budget and real execution. Retrieval cost included in amortized calculation via real embedding+retrieval timing. No hardcoded constants; all costs measured. End-to-end economics: analytical token counting without LLM calls overstates savings per agent prior #3; trajectory-grouped CIs required per prior #5.

Verification validity (real postconditions, trajectory-grouped): verify(mechanism_id, observed_state) checks postconditions on actual response/DOM state (DOM selector existence via Playwright evaluate, response status/header/body match) not on expected label. False accepts measured as verify()=true but observed_state functionally wrong (checked by independent oracle script using ground-truth selector/param/header from manifest not available to repair agent). Threshold calibration: verification operating threshold fit on TRAIN perturbations only (24 instances), evaluated on held-out TEST (24); post-state never leaks into pre-state features. Scores are real verify() confidences not deterministic instance_id-derived perfect-separation. AUROC/precision computed on real TEST scores with trajectory-grouped block permutation null (AUROC 0.4-0.6 for random); resampling unit = instance/trajectory block (not transition).

Adequacy and power: >=48 perturbation instances total (3 families x2 variants x8 seeds =48) with family-stratified TRAIN/TEST split (24 TRAIN, 24 TEST) yielding per-family TEST n=8 and pooled TEST n=24. Each family independent success/cost reported; pooled primary but per-family gates required. If any family TEST n<8 or total n<48 mark underpowered and primary per-family gate is exploratory (MIXED ceiling only). Pooled Wilson 95% CI half-width at p=0.8 n=24 is +-0.14; per-family n=8 half-width +-0.26 flagged exploratory. Upgrade to 72 instances (12 per-family TEST) if budget allows but 48 minimum for powered pooled decision with per-family exploratory. If pooled TEST n<24 MEASUREMENT_INVALID. 95% Wilson CIs for rates trajectory-grouped, bootstrap by instance-block (2000 resamples, trajectory-grouped) for cost ratios. Block-permutation nulls for retrieval and verification respect trajectory grouping per prior #5.

Determinism and reproducibility: fixed seeds for perturbation generation, nginx cache key generation, and LLM repair (temperature 0.0, seed where supported); all hashes use hashlib.sha256 never Python hash(); record all commits (graph/delta_repair code, runtime fixture), seeds manifest, model ids, nginx/Playwright versions, Playwright trace hashes, prompt logs. Exclude flaky network/external sites — localhost nginx+Flask only. Retry once on 5xx unrelated to perturbation or Playwright timeout >10s; if persistent infrastructure failure log and mark instance infrastructure-excluded (not repair failure) require n still >=48 else MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Evidence refs include raw DOM/a11y/headers/decompressed bytes not hash-only.

Byte-identity recomputation (real, non-vacuous): for each instance store SHA256(decompressed_body) for HIT, SWR, SIE, 304 pre and post via real nginx fetches with oracle-free decompression; post-perturbation HIT body for perturbed resource must differ from pre (mutation detected) while unperturbed resources remain >=0.99-equivalent. Decompression code path preserved from runtime fixture and hashed; any Content-Encoding/chunked/Vary handling divergence logged as substrate drift. Require full>body and full>status discrimination non-vacuous when header/body vary: if full==body==status==1.0 then C4 (primary) gated as MEASUREMENT_INVALID per prior #5.

Representation fidelity and agent-prior guards: raw observables preserved — full DOM snapshot + accessibility tree subset + response headers + decompressed body bytes + cache status header. No hash-only surrogate. Repair LLM is real gpt-4o-mini (record id, temperature, max_tokens, provider, per-call tokens, 15-step budget) not heuristic; browser interactions are Playwright-executed not counted simulation; semantic resolve is state-conditioned reconstruction vs literal replay with calibrated UNKNOWN abstention per prior #1; verification is discriminating with contamination bounded per prior #2; 0-token verbatim and RAG baselines are hit-capable with 0% hit-rate sanity per prior #4. Audit required_fixes 1-5 from EXP-GRAPH-35741890679/35752541832 explicitly addressed.
decision_rule: All thresholds applied on frozen pre-registered TEST data only (TRAIN used solely for verification threshold calibration). Trajectory-grouped uncertainty: rates via Wilson 95% CI by instance, cost ratios via instance-block bootstrap (2000 resamples) 95% CI, AUROC via DeLong/trajectory-block permutation. Gates: (C1) PC1 success=1.0 and PC2 repair success >=0.90 on real gpt-4o-mini pipeline and B-RUNTIME non-vacuous full>body and full>status discrimination demonstrated; else MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (C2) NC1 patch cost 0 and NC2 contamination=0 and random-patch block-permutation false-accept <=5% with AUROC 0.4-0.6 trajectory-grouped; else MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (C3) B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY pre-perturbation byte identity >=0.99 on real nginx (oracle-free greedy decode) and mutation detected post-perturbation; else MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Primary gates (require ALL to CONFIRM localized repair on TEST): (C4) repair success >=0.80 pooled AND >=0.70 per family on TEST (Wilson CI reported); (C5) mean repair tokens <0.50 * mean B-COLD tokens AND mean browser interactions <0.40 * B-COLD AND mean verification steps <=2 on TEST (bootstrap CI of ratio must be < threshold); (C6) contamination <0.10 (fraction unrelated mechanisms invalidated or false-accept) on TEST with N>=24 unrelated; (C7) verification AUROC >=0.75 and precision at TRAIN threshold >=0.80 on TEST; (C8) amortized cost at n_reuses=10 (repair+verification+10*retrieval_cost) < B-COLD cost (both tokens and browser) on TEST means with trajectory-grouped CI. CONFIRMED if C1-C8 all PASS. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any C4-C8 fails while C1-C3 PASS (valid negative, cost-bounded locality fails). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if C1-C3 fails or pooled TEST n<24 or substrate vacuous. MIXED if family-heterogeneous: >=1 family passes C4-C8 while another fails — report per-family ceilings, no pooled confirmation. Stable identifiers: M-repair_success_rate, M-repair_tokens_ratio_vs_cold, M-browser_ratio_vs_cold, M-verification_auroc, M-verification_precision, M-contamination_rate, M-false_accept_rate, M-amortized_cost_tokens_10, M-amortized_cost_browser_10, M-byte_identity_hit_swr_sie_304, M-retrieval_cost_tokens, B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION, B-VERBATIM-REPLAY, B-RETRIEVAL-RAG, B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH, B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY, PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS, NC-ZERO-AND-DISTANT-PERTURBATION. Effect sizes, 95% Wilson/bootstrap trajectory-grouped CIs, per-family breakdown required. This decision_rule preserves stable metric/control identifiers for AUDIT reuse.
product_consequence_positive: If CONFIRMED (C1-C8 PASS on real gpt-4o-mini + Playwright + verify with trajectory-grouped CIs and non-vacuous substrate), C-DELTA-REPAIR advances HYPOTHESIS -> EXPERIMENTAL (VALIDATED candidate pending replication) for single-resource local perturbations on real nginx HIT-cache localhost substrate. Justifies product architecture with localized repair boundaries: registry patch + verify loop rather than full task replay, with amortized cost advantage after 10 reuses (retrieval+verification+repair amortized). Next steps: expand perturbation radius (2-3 resources, cross-page), test distributed Redis session store and production CDN, integrate into SpiderKernel.invalidate()+distill() with freshness guard and calibrated UNKNOWN. Promotion to Product Core NOT authorized on localhost single-resource alone — requires cross-page and distributed validation.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (any C4-C8 fails while C1-C3 PASS on real trajectory-grouped measurement), single-resource locality fails even under minimal perturbations with real LLM/browse/verify, closing the smallest repair hypothesis. Product must default to full re-exploration or fused RAG+re-exploration for any drift and budget repair ≈ cold cost; must favor UNKNOWN/abstain per agent prior #1 when verification not discriminating or contamination >=0.10 or amortized >=cold. Delta-repair claim remains HYPOTHESIS/BLOCKED for broader radius; Graph lane should pivot to C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY matched families with end-to-end LLM economics or C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE calibrated abstention per Director comparative reasoning. A valid negative prevents shipping a repair layer that would cause contamination/false accepts and is high information for allocation.
estimated_cost: Medium: reuse runtime nginx+Flask HS256 fixture (0.5h setup, real nginx 1.2x), generate 48 perturbation instances (1h, real templates), run B-COLD with real gpt-4o-mini+Playwright 15 steps (48 instances * ~2k tokens ~96k tokens, 1.5h), run repair+verify loop per instance with real gpt-4o-mini (48 * ~1.5k tokens ~72k tokens, 1.5h), run retrieval RAG and verbatim baselines with block-permutation (0.5h), compute byte identity + contamination via real fetches trajectory-grouped (0.5h), analysis Wilson/bootstrap block-permutation (0.5h). Total ~6 compute-hours, ~170k tokens single model gpt-4o-mini, all localhost, no external sites beyond model API. If upgrade to 72 instances, ~255k tokens and ~8h.
expected_information_gain: Very high: first ever real LLM+Playwright+verify measurement of C-DELTA-REPAIR (0/230+ valid; prior 35741890679 was MEASUREMENT_INVALID simulation with hardcoded parameters that falsified C5/C8 as parameter artifacts; 35752541832 BLOCKED on missing LLM API). Directly tests SPIDER core compression promise 'pay novelty not whole task' with strong 0-token replay, trajectory-grouped retrieval, non-vacuous full>body verification, contamination and 10-reuse amortization economics, and verified byte-preserving substrate dependency. Either CONFIRMED (justifies repair architecture, unblocks residual-novelty amortization) or FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (closes cheapest repair hypothesis, prevents premature promotion, redirects Graph/Runtime/Product) materially changes claim C-DELTA-REPAIR state and next allocation. Advances beyond saturated FRESHNESS tunnel (r~0.002-0.046, TOST PASS at delta=0.15, 13/17 recent) per Director PIVOT cognitive_reset rationale; cross-lane unblocking per unit effort highest among alternatives (C-PARAM-INHERIT starved, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY needs this gate first, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE allocated to frontier).
